objective: Compute the total available today quantity of a specific Geberit Mapress Silent IC5-GU6 Valve and Connector (ball valve type) across all Vienna stores, including stores with zero availability, and report the count with citations of the product and every Vienna store record.

params.product_sku: discover from product_variants and product_variant_properties: brand='Geberit', series='Mapress Silent', model='IC5-GU6', product_name containing 'Valve and Connector', and a property with key='connector_type' value='ball valve' (case-insensitive, whitespace-trimmed)
params.vienna_store_ids: list of store_id from stores where city='Vienna' (case-insensitive, whitespace-trimmed)
params.total_available: sum of available_today_quantity from store_inventory for the discovered product_sku across all vienna_store_ids, using COALESCE or LEFT JOIN to treat missing inventory rows as 0
params.product_record_path: record_path of the discovered product variant
params.store_record_paths: list of record_path from stores where city='Vienna' (case-insensitive, whitespace-trimmed)
